question: What guardians are prescribed and at what height?
premises: The verse calls them Vaiṣṇavī guardians.
It says they are twenty-four angulas high.
inference: The prescribed guardians are Vaiṣṇavī and are twenty-four angulas high.
uncertainties: Their number is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Vaiṣṇavī guardians are said to be twenty-four angulas high.
